english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an aim or result someone is trying to achieve.
This is the all-purpose noun for a goal or objective.
This is the all-purpose choice for a goal or target that someone is striving to achieve.
Use this for a target to be reached or hit, especially a concrete goal.
Use this when the aspiration is framed as a concrete goal to work toward rather than a lofty dream.
Use this for the concrete goal or objective being pursued.
Use this when task means the objective or result to be achieved, not the work itself.
